courseOutcomes.description: Enumerate the different classes of computers and where they are used in everyday life.
Compute the effect of hardware/software enhancements on the speedup of a processor using Amdahl’s law.
Interpret possible dependencies that can cause hazards in a given block of code.
Summarize different strategies followed to ensure Instruction Level Parallelism.
Compare different strategies followed to ensure Instruction Level Parallelism and different strategies followed to ensure Data Parallelism.
Illustrate the need for memory consistency models and cache coherence protocols and explain the principle behind it.
